privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This site processes personal data only as needed to run the website, reply to contact requests and project briefs and — with your consent — measure traffic (Vercel Analytics and Google Analytics 4).
privacy.controllerBody: The data controller is {name} (sole proprietorship / Einzelunternehmen, Berlin).
privacy.hostingBody: The site is hosted by Vercel Inc. Technical logs (e.g. IP address, user agent, timestamp) may be created as needed for security and service stability.
privacy.formBody: When you submit the form, your name, email, optional phone number and message are processed solely to reply (Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR). The form is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection). Messages are delivered via Brevo (Sendinblue GmbH, Germany) as a processor; you may also receive an automatic acknowledgement. Data is not sold or used for marketing without separate consent. It is kept only as long as needed to handle the request, then deleted or archived where legally required.
privacy.briefBody: The optional brief collects your name, email, optional phone number and answers about the project (type, goals, scope, materials, languages, integrations, timeline) solely to prepare a proposal and reply (Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR). Protection, the processor (Brevo) and retention follow the same rules as the contact form. A draft in the browser (sessionStorage) is not sent until you submit; it is cleared after a successful send. I do not use this data for marketing without separate consent.
privacy.analyticsBody: After you accept analytics in the cookie banner, I load Vercel Analytics and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) with Google Consent Mode v2. Until you choose, all Google consent signals stay “denied”. On analytics accept I set analytics_storage=granted (ads signals ad_storage / ad_user_data / ad_personalization stay denied). Vercel Analytics measures traffic in a minimised way. GA4 (Google Ireland Ltd. / Google LLC) may then set analytics cookies (e.g. _ga). Without consent, or after “Necessary only”, GA does not run. Change preferences via Cookies in the footer. Legal basis with consent: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR.
privacy.cookiesBody: I use first-party cookies that are necessary for the site to work and to remember your consent choice. After analytics consent, Google Analytics cookies may be set. Consent lifetime: 12 months. You can change preferences anytime via the “Cookies” link in the footer.
privacy.cookieConsent: necessary — stores your analytics consent choice (version, analytics flag, date).
privacy.cookiesNoMarketing: I do not use advertising cookies or marketing trackers (e.g. Meta Pixel).
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection — email the controller.
privacy.complaintBody: You may lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority. For Berlin: Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit.

cookies.title: Cookies & analytics
cookies.body: I use necessary cookies (language and consent memory). Analytics (Vercel Analytics + Google Analytics 4) runs only with your consent — no advertising cookies.
